name: EasyPortalLinker
description: Point a wooden shovel at a Nether portal and EasyPortalLinker shows you EXACTLY where its counterpart must go in the other dimension — a full-height highlighted column from bedrock to build height, an axis-matched ghost outline of the obsidian frame at the recommended Y, and the exact coordinates. Build to the outline for a reliable link. Works both ways (Overworld <-> Nether). Client-side only.
